title: Mobility Equipment Fee Schedule — Purchase Amounts, Rental Fees, Purchase Option and Upgrade Terms
content:
# Summit Ridge Fee Schedule — Mobility Equipment

The Summit Ridge fee-schedule purchase amount of each Mobility Equipment class is the basis of rental fees, upgrade differences and repair-versus-replace. The rental fees are fee-schedule amounts per rental month: one amount for each of rental months 1 through 3, another for each rental month from month 4 on. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Fee schedule

| Class | Fee-schedule purchase amount | Rental fee, each of months 1 to 3 (per month) | Rental fee, each month from month 4 on (per month) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 438.40 | 43.84 | 32.88 |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 612.20 | 61.22 | 45.92 |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 862.00 | 86.20 | 64.65 |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 2486.00 | 248.60 | 186.45 |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 4024.80 | 402.48 | 301.86 |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 8977.60 | 897.76 | 673.32 |

## Rental month anchor

For every class the rule fixing each rental month's first day of service is the anniversary of the delivery date.

## Purchase option and upgrade terms

The first-month purchase option is whether the patient may elect to buy the chair outright in the first rental month instead of renting. The purchase election window is the number of calendar days after delivery within which the purchase election must be received; it is 0 when the class has no purchase option. Upgrade permitted is whether the patient may elect the class as an upgrade over a lower covered class and pay the difference; upgrade notice required is whether a signed notice is required before an upgrade difference can be billed to the patient.

| Class | First-month purchase option | Purchase election window (calendar days) | Upgrade permitted | Signed notice required for an upgrade difference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| K0001 | no | 0 | yes | yes |
| K0003 | no | 0 | yes | yes |
| K0004 | no | 0 | yes | yes |
| K0005 | yes | 30 | yes | yes |
| K0823 | no | 0 | yes | yes |
| K0856 | yes | 30 | yes | yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which rental fee does a given month carry?** Months 1, 2 and 3 each carry the months 1 to 3 amount; month 4 and every later month carry the amount for months from month 4 on. For a Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823), month 3 carries 402.48 and month 4 carries 301.86.
- **Which classes offer the first-month purchase option?** Only Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) and Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856), each with a 30-day election window.
- **Are upgrades open on every class?** Yes; every class shows upgrade permitted, and every class requires a signed notice before an upgrade difference is billed to the patient.
